Came in for an oil change left with a vehicle over heating with no coolant. Came back to ask questions on why my vehicle was drained of coolant and because I declined a flush in my opinion it was the cause of the over heating. And also the brand values was not honored along with paying for the oil change my oil filter was not changed. I was charged an additional fee for a diagnostic for a message to be relayed that I need a water pump and thermostat in the price range of 1150 and all of a sudden I had a coolant leak neither was true. My service experience was very unsatisfactory. The trust level for good work is none existent.

Came here for routine 60K mile service. Brakes, rotors, fluids, etc. was given a quote by manager  Mehvan which seemed a little high but within reason. Didn’t have time to complete the service that day so I told him I’d be back and made an appointment a couple weeks later. Return, ask for same services, was quoted a new price from new manager for exact same services which was $1K more than previous manager. I showed him quote, he stated this manager no longer works here, he can’t see it was calculated, this has always been the price, there’s war in the Middle East so prices are higher blah blah blah. Eventually told him I would take the car somewhere else, miraculously he returned with a new quote that was much closer to the old one. Not sure how that all worked out. Was in a pinch for time and wanted the work done before a long drive so I did end up staying. Service itself was decent,  staff were friendly enough and kept me updated but definitely wouldn’t go here again, and would recommend asking lots of questions and getting a second opinion on pricing.
